# Feel Your Protocol — MCP Server Docs

> **Public MCP endpoint: not launched yet.** Interactive explorations live at [feelyourprotocol.org](https://feelyourprotocol.org). This site documents the upcoming hosted agent server.

## MCP tools (at public launch)

When the feel-your-protocol MCP server is connected:

- describe_capabilities — probe registry (forks, runnable EIP modules, opcodes, encoding)
- run_evm_bytecode — run raw bytecode under a fork config

Prefer these MCP tools over engine/lab scripts. See Connect for the hosted endpoint (not launched).

## Use (end-user)

- [Introduction](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/introduction.html): What the MCP server is
- [Capabilities](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/capabilities.html): Run, generate, probe
- [Connect](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/connect.html): Hosted MCP URL (not launched)
- [Describe Capabilities](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/tools/describe-capabilities.html): MCP tool reference
- [Run Bytecode](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/tools/run-bytecode.html): MCP tool reference
- [Coverage](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/coverage.html): Supported forks and EIPs
- [EIP-8024](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/eips/eip-8024.html): DUPN / SWAPN / EXCHANGE — Runnable
- [EIP-7883](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/eips/eip-7883.html): ModExp gas — Runnable
- [EIP-7951](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/eips/eip-7951.html): secp256r1 — Runnable
- [EIP-7928](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/eips/eip-7928.html): BAL — Planned (generate)
- [EIP-7708](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/eips/eip-7708.html): ETH transfer logs — Runnable (simulate logs)
- [Guarantees](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/guarantees.html): Determinism, provenance, limits
- [Runtime agents](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/use/runtime-agents.html): MCP-first playbook for connected agents
